data_fields.name: hostile_area_forces_flag
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: hostile area, forcing quest or war mode keeps the flag on

data_fields.name: honour_grey_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: victim level at or below killer grey level gives no honour

data_fields.name: honour_same_team_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: same effective team gives no honour (except FFA realm)

best_idea: Make the hostile flag a timer that each hostile act restarts, paused in combat for the contest window and forced on in hostile zones, so the flag ends by itself after a quiet period.
decision_why: Keep the three-timer shape and the anti-farming honour gate; name the hard-coded 300 s and split the shared end-timer field; take no guard rule from this donor, since its game code has none.
acceptance: A server test: an attack marks both players contested for 30 s out of combat; a second attack restarts the decay; the flag clears 300 s after the last attack in a friendly zone and never in a hostile zone; a kill of a same-team player or of a victim at or below grey awards no honour.
